description: This file is a shell script (specifically a test script) for testing 'git init' functionality. It includes various test cases to verify the behavior of git initialization commands under different configurations and scenarios.

methods.name: check_config
methods.description: Checks if the given directory has a valid git configuration (contains 'config', 'refs' directories, and optionally 'config' executable), and whether 'config' is executable; verifies 'core.bare' and 'core.worktree' settings.

methods.name: check_long_base_path
methods.description: Creates a deep directory path to test 'git init' behavior with long file paths exceeding buffer sizes.

methods.name: sep_git_dir_worktree
methods.description: Sets up multiple repositories and linked worktrees, testing re-initialization behavior when moving git directories with relative and absolute paths.
